sections.title: Return
sections.sql: select r.number,ow.name as owner,ow.gst_number,r.period_start,r.period_end,r.issued_on,r.tonnes,round(r.sales_cents/100.0,2) as sales,round(r.costs_cents/100.0,2) as costs,round(r.net_cents/100.0,2) as net_to_owner from owner_returns r join owners ow on ow.id=r.owner_id where r.id=$1

sections.title: By grade and buyer
sections.note: Tonnes are the buyer's received tonnes where reported, otherwise the weighbridge.
sections.sql: select product,customer,count(*)::int as loads,round(sum(tonnes),3) as tonnes,round(sum(sale_cents)/100.0,2) as sales,round(sum(sale_cents)/sum(tonnes)/100.0,2) as per_tonne from v_owner_lines where owner_return_id=$1 group by product,customer order by sales desc

sections.title: Costs
sections.sql: select round(sum(logging_cents)/100.0,2) as logging,round(sum(cartage_cents)/100.0,2) as cartage,round(sum(levy_cents)/100.0,2) as growers_levy,round(sum(mgmt_cents)/100.0,2) as management_fee,round(sum(owner_net_cents)/100.0,2) as net_to_owner,round(sum(owner_net_cents)/sum(tonnes)/100.0,2) as net_per_tonne from v_owner_lines where owner_return_id=$1

sections.title: Every load
sections.sql: select docket,loaded_on,harvest,product,customer,tonnes,round(sale_cents/100.0,2) as sale,round(owner_net_cents/100.0,2) as net from v_owner_lines where owner_return_id=$1 order by loaded_on,docket

name: invoice
title: Tax invoice
for_each: select i.id,i.number from invoices i where not i.buyer_created

sections.title: Invoice
sections.sql: select s.business_name as from_business,s.gst_number as our_gst_number,i.number,c.name as bill_to,c.gst_number as their_gst_number,i.issued_on,i.due_on,round(i.amount_cents/100.0,2) as excl_gst,round(i.gst_cents/100.0,2) as gst,round((i.amount_cents+i.gst_cents)/100.0,2) as total from invoices i join customers c on c.id=i.customer_id cross join settings s where i.id=$1

sections.title: Loads
sections.sql: select docket,loaded_on,product,tonnes,round(price_cents/100.0,2) as per_tonne,round(sale_cents/100.0,2) as amount from v_loads where invoice_id=$1 order by loaded_on,docket

name: contractor-invoice
title: Buyer-created tax invoice
for_each: select p.id,p.number from contractor_payments p where p.buyer_created

sections.title: Taxable supply information
sections.note: Created by the buyer under an agreement with the supplier. Both GST numbers must show.
sections.sql: select p.number,k.name as supplier,k.gst_number as supplier_gst_number,s.business_name as buyer,s.gst_number as buyer_gst_number,k.bcti_agreement_on as agreement_on,p.kind,p.period_end,p.issued_on,p.tonnes,round(p.amount_cents/100.0,2) as excl_gst,round(p.gst_cents/100.0,2) as gst,round((p.amount_cents+p.gst_cents)/100.0,2) as total from contractor_payments p join contractors k on k.id=p.contractor_id cross join settings s where p.id=$1

sections.title: Loads
sections.sql: select docket,loaded_on,harvest,customer,tonnes,round(case when logging_pay_id=$1 then logging_cents else cartage_cents end/100.0,2) as amount from v_loads where logging_pay_id=$1 or cartage_pay_id=$1 order by loaded_on,docket

name: harvest-notice
title: Notice of harvesting (draft)
for_each: select o.id,o.code from operations o where o.status in ('planned','active') and o.planned_start is not null

sections.title: Notice
sections.note: NES-CF regulation 64: the place, and the dates harvesting is planned to begin and end. Use your council's own form if it has one.
sections.sql: select n.harvest,n.forest,f.region,n.regional_council,n.territorial_authority,o.area_ha,n.starts_on as planned_start,o.planned_end,n.window_opens,n.give_by,n.given_on,o.plan_in_place_on from v_notices n join operations o on o.id=n.operation_id join forests f on f.id=o.forest_id where n.operation_id=$1 and n.kind='harvest'

sections.title: By month
sections.note: Levy rate from settings. Deducted means the buyer took it from the payment; the rest is the owner's to pay.
sections.sql: select to_char(month,'YYYY-MM') as month,tonnes,round(levy_due_cents/100.0,2) as levy_due,round(deducted_by_buyers_cents/100.0,2) as deducted_by_buyers,round(owner_to_pay_cents/100.0,2) as owner_to_pay,owner_paid_on from v_levy where owner_id=$1 order by month
